reviews.comment: She was an okay prof. She gives pop quizzes but she lets you know ahead of time what it will be over. It is easy to succeed if you go to class. She does take attendance, but her lectures were usually interesting and easy to follow. The quizzes and tests were somewhat difficult so you do have to study a little bit but it's not hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVED Dr. Suzuki. Things could be disorganized at times, but was always rectified quickly. She tells you when & what material the "pop" quizzes are over. I genuinely loved the readings/discussions. I can see why people would not like the class since it is more of a traditional face to face class & not a blow off. I loved her personal anecdotes.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is a very nice person, however she was gone a lot and she made all of the TA's do a lot of the work. The class was very disorganized and we were so off track of the syllabus. The final is 40% of your grade and the midterm is 30%, for the material presented in this class, this class is way more difficult than it needs to be.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Suzuki does not do anything online. All notes, quizzes, and exams are on paper. Notes are not uploaded to Canvas, and there are very little graded assignments (which can be both good and bad). 5 pop quizzes, 2 writing assignments, midterm and a final. Probably would not take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shes a nice person, but not a good teacher. Your grade is based on the 2 tests and pop quizzes, so no room to make errors. She had a total of 3 TA's and still very unorganized. each tests were based on 10+ chapters. Too much info for one test. Study guide basically said "Know everything we've ever learned in this class". Don't take for an elective.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Suzuki was great, but this class was difficult for me. No homework, so your grade is solely based off quizzes and 2 exams. If you don't buy the textbook and come to lecture you will miss out on notes for the pop quizzes. The grade book the entire semester was disorganized, so I wasn't aware of my grade till last minute(could've been a TA issue)
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was mainly focused on quizzes based on readings from an expensive textbook, she does not post the readings and the readings along with the quizzes were vague, long, and hard reads. There are two tests, the midterm and the final, a study guide was given but it was little to no help. Midterm and final were based on around 13 sets of notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Suzuki is the definition of girlboss. She's honestly one of the most interesting people I've ever met, but her class is pretty difficult to maintain an A in. 7 pop quizzes and 2 tests determine your grade with two mandatory extra credit assignments. The quizzes come with a warning but the questions are often meant to fool us (all true/false).
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Suzuki was one of the sweetest professors I've ever had, but her class wasn't the best. Its only grades are about 5-7 pop quizzes, a midterm, and a final, followed by two "extra credit" assignments that are graded like quizzes. All her notes are in person on provided paper notes guided by powerpoints she'll never post. Post grades VERY late.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Truly the kindest and one of the funnier profs here.  She can be a bit hard to understand at first, but of course this isn't her fault and she really does care about everyone in her class.  Exams can be hard if you aren't good at memorizing exact definitions, and there are a lotttt of notes to study for it.  Extra-Credit is a game changer
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked her! She is very kind and so funny out of nowhere. The "pop quizzes" come with a warning every single time so that's not a big concern. A few extra credit opportunities (they're mandatory but still help.) Lectures can get a bit boring at times but just go to class and take notes and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Suzuki isn't a bad professor but her lectures can be boring but attendance is crucial since she uses fill-in-the-blank notes. She has pop quizzes but will say when they are. Only 2 exams + pop quizzes + 2 extra credit assignments. It is not an easy class but doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Suzuki! She includes fun little anecdotes throughout her lectures - which are a good mix of lecturing and watching videos/movies. Not much homework outside of class except a little textbook reading. There are pop quizzes but dw she tells you ahead of time. Make sure to study for the midterm and final well, and do the extra credit!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very rude when you ask questions. grade is based off of midterm and final and 4 pop quizzes. requires you to memorize 10+ chapters of notes to do well on the exams
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took her class in the Spring of 2022, and I enjoyed it! She's passionate about what she teaches, and her exams are very easy as long as you study her notes. She prints out fill-out notes for all of her lectures, so don't forget to bring those every class so you can stay on top of them! There was an extra credit opportunity as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class was graded based on two exams and pop quizzes. She is tough to understand and is not friendly when questions are asked. Tests are extremely difficult and require exact definitions to be memorized. I 100% recommend not taking her if you are wanting a professor who is understanding and makes class fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Suzuki is an incredible professor with really interesting stories from the field! lectures are really interesting but there is a lot of reading outside of class. There are quizzes and exams you won't pass unless you study really well but she did give extra credit. Dr. Suzuki wants to see you succeed and I would 100% take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class thoroughly. Attendance is based on "pop" quizzes. I say "pop" bc she will tell you exactly when it is and how to prepare for it. No hw besides reading but I didn't read much and did fine. Just pay attention to lectures. she gives out fill in the blank notes which show up verbatim on the test. xcred is vv generous if she does it
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Respected--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although she has some neg reviews, I really enjoy Dr. Suzuki and this class. Her way of doing lecture notes makes it very easy to follow along and comprehend the lectures. Her accent is slightly strong, but as long as you're paying attention, you will be okay. This class isn't easy, but I really have enjoyed it and am learning tons.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is nice, but her grading is hard! There is a lot of reading to do, and attendance is taking by the qiuz. There is Extra Credit for the test. Over all she is okay, but there is not mach you can do about her class if you do bad on the test.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The only reason I'm making a decent grade in this class is because of the review session held by the TA. Her tests are very specific and fill in the blank definitions must be word for word. Dr. Suzuki is impossible to understand with her accent but luckily her notes follow her lecture slides which aren't posted online so you have to go to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I enjoyed the content of the class. No papers to write. Pop quizzes based on readings and a midterm and a final. Her English is very broken, so it's tough to understand. She reads straight off her ppt which can be boring. If info is not covered in lecture due to time constraint, she still expects you to know it for her midterm and final.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She says that there is a lot of required reading, but really, it is not required at all since the answers she is looking for on tests/papers/pop quizzes (which she will tell you about in advance) are on her worksheets,which are amazing. I am a computer science major, so I don't really read or write much, and I'm getting an A with hardly any effort.

If you want your life to be filled only with reading, then take the course.  I dropped it because I didn't have time to read for my other classes.  Also, if you can't understand Japanese, I wouldn't take the class.
Required A LOT of readings. At least one reading paper per week. Although the course itself is fun, the readings and papers are just about to kill everyone...So, be awared of it...
